## 决策请求 · #33696 (epic #33631 R4) · 2026-11-15T09:38Z

Governing text: the R4 ruling on epic #33631 (ranked list 6889544281, correction 6889939163): drop the parent chain only when the FK is required, "No change to which rows any reader sees". Measurement: os-dev report 6892424473 (real engine, SqlDriver + SecurityPlugin + SharingService, origin/main d7e1a5aa).

**前提不成立:** master FK 设成必填后,仍有三种方式存进「孤儿」明细行(系统身份插入一个不存在的主记录、系统身份把 FK 改指向不存在的行、字段改成必填时已有 FK 为空的行;前两种 `engine-referential-integrity.ts` 已记为已知缺口)。今天父链把这些行对管理员也藏起来;去掉父链后管理员会看到它们,所以「任何读者看到的行不变」不成立。

| 选项 | 业务效果 | 工作量 |
|---|---|---|
| **A(推荐)** 修订裁决:每一跳读范围都不受限时去掉父链,管理员在自己租户内也能看到孤儿行 | 管理员列表快 29–42%(卡上实测),不移动任何权限边界;唯一变化是本就违反主从约束、今天谁都看不见的行 | S–M |
| B 先在源头堵住孤儿(系统写也校验主记录;有空 FK 时拒绝改必填),再按原裁决上线 | 结果最干净,但面更大,种子数据与安装顺序有风险 | M–L |
| C 维持现状,搁置 R4 | 无变化,无收益;R3 的 SQLite 一半继续被挡 | 0 |

## Four facets

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 让「不受限读者」真正不受限,B 是防孤儿的正确后续,可另立卡不必挡 A;C 留下实测的管理员读税。
② 实际业务拉动: 每次管理员列表读都受益(卡上实测 29–42%)。
③ 防 AI 犯错: A 不放宽任何受限读者;孤儿行变可见反而让数据错误暴露出来。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A 面最小且有收益;B 扩到写路径与发布门。

**推荐 A**,B 另立后续卡。这是安全读范围的语义,属维护者人工裁决。

State: `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`, assignee cleared (claim 6892260838 released by this stroke; empty branch `claude/area-A2-33696` stays as a marker). Area S1 re-claims after the ruling.

Claim amendment · 2026-11-15T10:44Z · to claim 6893117018 · file surface widened by the area (routing, no ruling change)

Added: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, at most 4 lines, all inside the host literal of the private method `composeReadableIdsChain`: a `_registry` getter shaped like the other host literals. The reason: only the engine sees the per-hop scope answer the ruling (6893097935) requires, and it must also read whether the leaf's master_detail field is required. Dropping the leaf at the source instead would make the synchronous cbp read filter async, which reaches further. No behaviour change in engine.ts, and no public surface move. domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Re-ruled: option 「只对管理员去掉」 (drop the chain for administrators only) · the maintainer (Steedos) on the seat thread decision card (2026-11-15T11:31Z), after an independent Fable re-review. **This replaces record 6893097935.**

Why it was re-asked: 6893097935 (decision request 6892447012) did not show the maintainer two recorded decisions it reversed. They are #24932 ruling B item 4 (comment 6303721609, 10-20, ⛔ "no interim removal of the predicate for an unrestricted master scope: it would expose rows with a null or dangling foreign key (measured)") and ADR-0139 D6 (docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md:295-297). As written it would also have shown members unowned rows, against #30905 ruling A (11-06, ADR-0055: rows with no master are visible only to their owner and to view-all holders on the detail). Area S1 found this while building.

Ruling as it binds this card:
- The parent chain is dropped only for a reader who holds view-all on the detail AND whose every master hop answers unrestricted (the engine's per-hop scope, not `hasSuperuserReadBypass`), with a required master FK. That reader sees null and dangling-FK rows inside its own tenant wall, consistent with #30905 ruling A. Every other reader, members included, keeps the chain unchanged.
- This deliberately lifts #24932 ruling B item 4 and ADR-0139 D6's ⛔ for that reader class only. **The PR must not land before the ADR-0139 status-line amendment** (citing this record; ADR-0055's 10-22 note in step) merges. That amendment is a docs/adr/** card for the skills lane, which the seat files.
- Pins: the three controlled-by-parent-leaf-switch tests are rewritten for the view-all + unrestricted reader. Reverse pins stay: a reader with a restricted master hop, and a reader with view-all on the detail only, still never see null or dangling rows.
- Release note: totals, counts and aggregates for that reader may include orphan rows. A follow-up card to close the orphan sources (option B of the original request) is owed as the PR's one loose-ends card.
- Multi-tenant deployments: a tenant admin's master scope is the tenant wall, so it is not unrestricted. No speed-up there, by design; widening that is a separate decision.

State: stays `pm:dispatched` with area S1 (branch claude/area-A2-33696 pushed, no PR). The route is now narrower; S1 reworks it to this ruling.
